metadata.case_title: Commissioner Of Income-Tax vs Braj Bhushan Cold Storage
metadata.summary: The case involved the revision of an order dropping penalty proceedings under section 271(1)(c) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, due to nil tax payable by the assessee. The Commissioner of Income-tax revised the order under section 263, holding the penalty imposable. The Tribunal allowed the appeal, questioning the revision under section 263 and the time bar for penalty imposition. The court held that the order revision was justified as the penalty was applicable, but the penalty order was time-barred. The court discussed the limitation provisions and the retrospective effect of amendments, ruling in favor of the Revenue on the penalty limitation issue.
